subject: Human Evolution
title: The Mismatch Problem
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Mismatch Problem.

hook.text: Your body craves sugar, fat, and salt. On the savanna those were rare and valuable. Now they're everywhere.

buildup.text: Evolution wired us to gorge when these nutrients appeared, because scarcity was the norm.

discovery.text: Modern food engineering exploits these ancient cravings: hyper-palatable foods hijack reward circuits.

twist.text: Obesity, diabetes, and heart disease are mismatch diseases—ancient biology in a modern food landscape.

climax.text: Our genes haven't changed, but our environment has. The result is a global health crisis.

punchline.text: Stone-age appetites in a supermarket world.

quiz.question: What is an evolutionary mismatch disease?
options: A condition caused by ancient adaptations in modern environments
